description: Structural example for all three Class B (memory log) cells: volatile log semantics, projection reuse where configured, claim/finalize and request-id invariants. This fixture is not execution evidence; PostgreSQL commands require a live fixture.

entries.command: cargo test -p fireweed --features memory,turso --test p5_class_b_reopen p5_memory_memory_volatility_reopen -- --exact --nocapture
entries.notes: Class B process-local volatility: empty reopen; request_id ledger not retained

entries.command: cargo test -p fireweed --features memory,turso --test p5_class_b_reopen p5_memory_turso_projection_reopen -- --exact --nocapture
entries.notes: Projection reuse does not upgrade the volatile memory log to durable Class A; checks exact replay, counters and claim/finalize behavior.
